description: Live provider status, stack-wide outage verdicts, incident timelines, and independent uptime history for 172 cloud and SaaS vendors from their official status feeds.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http outagedeck https://outagedeck.com/api/mcp

notes: Public status, incident, and uptime tools require no account or API key.
Account-specific custom-provider and alert tools optionally authenticate with an OutageDeck API key or OAuth 2.1.
MCP initialize and tools/list succeeded against the public endpoint on 2026-08-05.
Active in the official MCP Registry as com.outagedeck/outagedeck-status version 1.1.0.
